name: Time and Time Range Picker Field
description: Two field types (time, and time range) whose widget attaches a Materialize clock picker to a text input.
project_description: Provides two field types, "Time Picker" (a single time of day) and "Time Range Picker" (a start and end time), for storing times without a date attached. The widget renders a plain text input and attaches the Materialize clock/modal time picker via JavaScript; the Materialize library is loaded from the cdnjs CDN. Per-field storage settings choose one of five color themes (default, sky blue, iris blue, parrot green, dark gray) and a 12-hour or 24-hour clock. Submitted values are validated with a regular expression against the chosen hour format, and the range widget additionally checks that end is not earlier than start. Stored as plain strings (VARCHAR 255).
